claims.description: Table 1 (page 6), Total Catastrophic Risk by 2100, Superforecasters median, in %. Code: column 'median' of all_tables_next for question 'Total Catastrophic', group 'super'
Table 1, Total Catastrophic Risk by 2100, Experts median, in %. Code: same, group 'expertG1'
Table 1, Total Extinction Risk by 2100, Superforecasters median, in %. Code: question 'Total Extinction', group 'super'

notes: Claims are Table 1's first three point estimates read row by row; bracketed bootstrap CIs are not point estimates. Values confirmed in the PDF text layer, page 6. Tolerance: the protocol rule (1% or 3 units of the last printed digit, whichever is larger) would give +-3 percentage points for '20%' and '1%', which is too loose to mean anything; I tighten it to 0.03 percentage points for all three before running (stricter than the protocol, never looser). Group labels from functions.R: 'super' (N=89) and 'expertG1' (all experts, N=80), matching the Table 1 note. README warns of 'minor discrepancies' from number storage; reported as is.
